name: Call of Water
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
If there is one lesson you must learn of water, it is this: water means rebirth.

Its power flows, erodes, and makes clean all manner of things. You will find its ability to heal and replenish incomparable, but only when it is pure.

When you understand that water, when polluted, can devastate all that it touches, you will appreciate how vital a resource it is.

If you wish the water sapta, find Brine deep in Southern Barrens. Her home is continually molested by the quilboar there.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes?

Mmm. I have a feeling I know what you're going to ask me: what would possess someone to live out here in the deepest part of the Barrens, the threat of quilboar all around, and no protection? Well, we all have our reasons to justify why we act the way we do. The real question is, what brings a lowly friend to the deepest reaches of the Barrens to speak to a woman who obviously has no concern for her own well-being?

I'm willing to bet we both know the answer to that.

chain.subtitle: 14 quests from level 20 to 23, 9,590 XP in all.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the watering hole below Brine's hut and return it to her in the Barrens.

quests.objectiveText: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at the well in Tarren Mill and return to Brine in the Barrens.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Fill the Empty Blue Waterskin at the Ruins of Stardust in Ashenvale and return to Brine in the Barrens.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Defeat the Corrupt Manifestation of Water and place the Corrupted Manifestation's Bracers along with the Remaining Drops of Purest Water on the Brazier of Everfount in Silverpine F

quests.objectiveText: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Silverpine Forest.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Shard of Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

quests.name: Call of Water
